page_title: Realtime Django Part 3: Build a Chat application with django, RabbitMQ and Vue.js (Build an API with django rest framework)

summary.title: Realtime Django Part 3: Build a Chat application with django, RabbitMQ and Vue.js (Build an API with django rest framework)
summary.one_liner: You learn how to build a Django REST framework API for starting chat sessions, joining them, posting messages and fetching message history, and how RabbitMQ and uWSGI fit into a real-time chat architecture.
takeaways: Create a Django app with models for chat sessions, messages and members, then run migrations.
Build DRF API views (without serializers) for starting sessions, joining via PATCH, posting messages and fetching history.
Understand why the join endpoint takes a username from the request body rather than using request.user, enabling invites.
See how RabbitMQ exchanges and queues decouple Django from the uWSGI WebSocket server that delivers messages to clients.
summary.summary: This is Part 3 of a series on building a realtime chat app with Django, RabbitMQ and Vue.js. It explains the high-level architecture, where Django forwards messages to RabbitMQ, which routes them through exchanges and queues to workers and a uWSGI WebSocket server. The implementation section walks through creating a chat Django app, defining models, and writing DRF views for chat sessions, joining, posting messages and retrieving history. It also discusses design choices such as an idempotent PATCH join and using usernames rather than request.user. The page notes that the next part builds the Chat UI in Vue.
